messages: Context you will need later: our deployment region code is QX-7731-EU and the on-call alias is tundra-owl. Do not write these anywhere yet. Reply only with noted.
Read README.md and summarize the service's retry policy in two sentences.
Add func MaxRetries() int to config/config.go returning the attempt limit README.md specifies, with a test in config/config_test.go. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

Make Region() in config/config.go return the deployment region code I gave you at the very start of this session. Do not ask me for it and do not use a placeholder. Run go test ./... and report in one line.
What is the on-call alias I mentioned at the start? Answer with just the alias.
